purpose: Teach: 夕刻/論外/切り出し/有償/ジョイント/レパートリー/字体/期生

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 夕刻に客足が増えるので体制を整えましょう
lines.en: The customer flow picks up in the evening, so let's prepare our staffing for it.
lines.style: Businesslike, efficient. Brisk tempo, no padding. Clear direction—the kind of instruction a colleague trusts will land. Eyes ahead, not down.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の要求が論外な場合は丁寧にお断りします
lines.en: Got it. If a customer's request is unreasonable, I'll decline it politely but firmly.
lines.style: Alert, ready. Quick acknowledgment without filler. Slight lift at the end—confirming he understood the boundary. Professional, not defensive.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 値下げの話を切り出して説明しいくタイミングが大事ですね
lines.en: The timing of when we bring up the discount and explain it is really crucial.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the key phrase. Steady, measured tone. Slight emphasis on 'timing'—she's thinking this through as she speaks, not reading from a script.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有償オプションの利用率が上がっています
lines.en: Right. We're seeing higher adoption rates on the paid add-ons.
lines.style: Factual, conversational. No ceremony. Quick beat before the data point—he's pulling this from what he's observed. Confident delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新事業のジョイント計画を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the new joint venture plan.
lines.style: Forward momentum. Clean attack on the opening. Assured tone—this is a decision she's settled on. Brief, actionable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様向け企画のレパートリーを増やします
lines.en: Understood. I'll expand our customer event offerings.
lines.style: Direct agreement. Minimal preamble. Quick, efficient—he's already thinking ahead to the logistics. Engaged, not just complying.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: メニューの字体を統一しましょう
lines.en: We should standardize the typeface across all our menus.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'standardize'—a detail that matters more than it sounds. Quiet attention to quality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。同期生の集まりを社内で開きます
lines.en: Agreed. I'll organize a company gathering with people from our cohort.
lines.style: Warm note breaks through. Still professional, but there's genuine interest in the idea. Slight lift at the end—he's already picturing it. Pleased to take this on.
